title: Dyson V8 Origin Stick Vacuum Cleaner $299 (Was $599) Delivered to Metro Only @ Mobileciti via Click Frenzy
body:
Deal: Dyson V8 Origin Stick Vacuum Cleaner $299 (Was $599) Delivered to Metro Only @ Mobileciti via Click Frenzy

[whichwhatwho] The year is 3200.
Dyson still sell the v8 stick vac and people for some reason, still buy it.
[incipient] We have the v7 and it's perfect. Perfect in the sense it effectively sucks up stuff, the battery life is good, and the bin is easy to empty.
For $299 it's great (assuming the v8 doesn't have some battery management issues?). Spending $1k on a v11 or whatever would be a very hard sell for single income/less disposable income households.
[boomramada] Im sorry to say, its 3201 and you can still buy this , point is it still do the job at the fraction of release price.
[BigBucko] I still have my V6. 15 years later still works and does the job. Cars go A to B, toothbrushes clean teeth, phones used to give and take calls, list goes on. Vacuum cleans…all I need.
[ImTheGiftCardGuy] It sucks that you need to have a metro postcode or you can't buy it.
[Tanvry] it's mostly because shipping costs a lot more for non metro areas
[jasswolf] The V8 Cyclone - the updated model which has an upgraded motor and higher capacity battery - goes on sale for this price.
How is this a good deal?
[FiveDarrah] The main reason i'm not buying into the V8 Cyclone is not having third party battery options or the ability to use adapters.
A replacement battery is $150 from dyson. Even if the V8 cyclone drops to $300 (and I think it did once), I would not buy it.
An open system is more of a selling point to me and the V8 is famous for their battery versatility. That is really the main thing that goes. In turn you can also find parts and repair it more easily than other models or brands. This is the benefit of an open system.
It's a shame they locked it down for the cyclone model. I do want a toggle switch without a 3rd party hack.
At this point I might go with one of the other brands that were mentioned on ozb that cost half the price of this.
[jasswolf] Nothing has been locked down, the aftermarket options are spinning up.
[OzWaster] Decent… more or less the usual sale price for this
[jasswolf] This hasn't gone on sale for a year because it's been discontinued.
They brought the functionality of the V10 Cyclone down to V8 prices and now we have the V8 Cyclone.
